brief.scope: Read ../in/security-followup-review-57.md and ../in/RULING.md WHOLE. Independently verify the repaired resume settlement and canonical snapshot binding with safe isolated probes. No writes to implementation/tests, real store or outside fixture; no broad suites or vendor calls. Declared live-containment P2 remains unmeasured. Report only actual defects, not a P3 command diary.

findings.claim: A schema-invalid resumed envelope retains malformed count values. When prior findings exist, _retain_findings compares a vendor-controlled string with integers and raises an uncaught TypeError before _settle. Thus malformed vendor output can bypass the repaired read-role settlement and leave residual changes unrecorded.
findings.reproduce:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/dispatch python3 - <<'PY'
import json, launch
prior={'findings':[{'severity':'p1','where':'prior','claim':'kept','reproduce':'true'}],'counts':{'p1':1,'p2':0,'p3':0,'opinions':0}}
candidate={'job':'review','status':'ok','verdict':'approve','counts':{'p1':'vendor-string','p2':0,'p3':0,'opinions':0},'findings':[],'artifacts':{},'spend':{},'stamp':{'ref':'ignored'},'note':None}
env=launch._envelope(json.dumps(candidate).encode(),'review','a'*40,harness='grok')
print(env['status'], type(env['counts']['p1']).__name__)
launch._retain_findings(env,prior)
PY

findings.claim: Relocation rebases snapshot.root but leaves harness.isolation.env, home, and store at their old absolute locations. Resume restores sessions beneath the current job but launches Codex/Grok with the stale home path, breaking relocated resumes and permitting vendor reads or writes outside the current job.
findings.reproduce:
DISPATCH_JOBS=/__agentscient_audit_absent_current__ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/dispatch python3 - <<'PY'
import launch
ident='20260904T000000Z-review-codex-abcdef'
old=f'/__agentscient_audit_absent_old__/{ident}'
rec={'id':ident,'snapshot':{'root':old+'/snapshot'},'harness':{'isolation':{'env':{'CODEX_HOME':old+'/home/codex'},'home':old+'/home/codex','store':old+'/home/codex/sessions'}}}
job,snapshot,rec=launch._bind_record(rec,ident)
print(rec['snapshot']['root'])
print('expected',job/'home/codex')
print('actual',rec['harness']['isolation']['env']['CODEX_HOME'])
assert rec['harness']['isolation']['env']['CODEX_HOME'] != str(job/'home/codex')
PY

findings.claim: Record validation does not constrain snapshot.ref_sha. Resume now settles using that record value as `${ref_sha}..${head}` without a `--` separator, so Git parses an option-like ref. Options such as `--output=<outside-path>` can make settlement write outside the job before invalidating the envelope.
findings.reproduce:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=ops/devlane/dispatch python3 - <<'PY'
import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
import launch,record
rec=json.loads(Path('.dev/records/dispatches/20260904T230616Z-code-codex-65775d.json').read_text())
rec['snapshot']['ref_sha']='--stat-width=0'
record.validate(copy.deepcopy(rec))
arg=f"{rec['snapshot']['ref_sha']}..{'a'*40}"
p=launch._git(Path('.'),'diff','--name-only',arg,check=False)
print('validated:',arg)
print(p.returncode,p.stderr.strip())
assert 'expects a numerical value' in p.stderr
PY

envelope.note: Read both ruled inputs and the complete 883-line patch; its SHA-256 matched the requested Git diff. No dependency, lockfile, fetched-action, SQL, shell-construction, template, credential, private-key, or common API-token addition was found. Filesystem-backed dirty/no-stream and symlink probes could not run because the audit sandbox exposed no writable temporary directory; pure read-only probes were used instead.
